subject.title: fix(whatsapp): suppress typing for unmentioned group runs regardless of delivery mode

question: Should WhatsApp land this narrow all-unmentioned `suppressTyping` mitigation now, or wait for the broader visible-delivery send-start boundary in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90477?
rationale: Both paths can address false WhatsApp typing indicators, but tests cannot settle the user-visible tradeoff where proactive unmentioned visible replies lose their typing flash.

options.title: Rebase The Narrow Mitigation
options.body: Refresh this branch onto current main, adapt the predicate to `conversationKind` and `groupMention`, and keep the command, mention, direct-chat, and automatic-delivery coverage.

options.title: Prefer Visible Delivery
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90477 as the canonical path only after its conflicts and plugin/API compatibility risks are resolved.

options.title: Keep Current Behavior For Now
options.body: Leave automatic unmentioned group turns with their current typing behavior until a stronger live repro or UX decision raises priority.

recommendation.title: Rebase The Narrow Mitigation
recommendation.body: Refresh this branch onto current main, adapt the predicate to `conversationKind` and `groupMention`, and keep the command, mention, direct-chat, and automatic-delivery coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr owns the overlapping visible-delivery typing PR and has merged history in the WhatsApp inbound dispatch area.
